_comment: Signer allowlist for the npm publish attestation gate (scripts/publish-attestation-gate.sh).
identity whose cosign attestation the publish gate honors is this repo's own base-ref signing
workflow (.github/workflows/review-gate.yml on main) under the GitHub Actions OIDC issuer.
Exact identity, never a regexp: a pattern that matched any Actions workflow (or a PR-head
controlled one) would let a non-independent job mint a pass. The publish gate reads this file
from the release PR's BASE ref, so a PR cannot widen its own signer set.
